title: Milan Effect Brick: From Material to Design Identity
description: Discover how Milan Effect Brick transforms light into a design element, combining Italian innovation with refined aesthetics to create elegant and inspiring living spaces.
author: MVN Group
content:
A refined combination of sustainable materials and Italian-inspired design, bringing modern, elegant, and inspiring living spaces. From functionality to aesthetics, every detail is thoughtfully expressed through each individual brick.

Light-effect bricks represent a new interior material trend introduced in Italy earlier this year, opening a new approach to enhancing the role of light within living spaces.

Light is not simply a tool for illumination. It can also become a decorative element, a focal point, and a way to influence emotions. This versatility raises an important design challenge: how can light be connected with interior materials to create a harmonious composition and convey meaningful experiences to homeowners?

Architects often use solutions such as vertical screens, breeze blocks, and layered structures to filter and control natural light. Beyond that, they continue shaping the surrounding spaces to maximize the emotional impact of light. When interacting with materials such as wood or velvet, light becomes softer and warmer, creating a sense of comfort and relaxation. In contrast, reflective materials like glossy tiles enhance brightness and bring a more luxurious atmosphere. Many interior designers also elevate lighting experiences through translucent stone, whose distinctive surface transforms light into a unique design feature that expresses personality and character.

A New Approach to Connecting Light and Interior Materials

The growing investment in interior materials that interact with light reflects homeowners’ increasing interest in creating more expressive living environments. However, despite this demand, the global market has remained limited in materials capable of actively engaging with and enhancing natural light.

To develop a product that combines the distinctive patterns of translucent stone with the wide reflective surface of glossy tiles, an Italian tile manufacturer explored unique natural crystals such as mother-of-pearl and amber. By studying the light diffusion properties of layered crystals and recreating these effects through advanced printing technology, they developed a new generation of material: light-effect bricks.

 

 

The unique feature of light-effect bricks lies in their appearance, resembling a translucent gemstone surface. In reality, this is a visual effect created when external light interacts with the material. Most remarkably, the beauty of these bricks transforms dramatically from different viewing angles, revealing diverse layers of color and depth. This dynamic interaction brings a sense of vitality, elegance, and exclusivity to the space.

 

 

The first light-effect brick collection, Tele di Marmo Lumia, was introduced at the prestigious Salone del Mobile 2025 interior design exhibition in Milan. With its impressive beauty and captivating visual effects, the collection received high appreciation from visitors and design enthusiasts.

Tele di Marmo Lumia provides architects with new possibilities for flexible lighting design while helping homeowners achieve their desired lighting experiences within their living spaces. Recognizing the potential of this collection, Vietceramics became the first and only brand to promptly introduce the collection from Milan to Vietnam, enabling architects to bring innovative design inspiration to homeowners seeking personalized spaces.

Architects can visit Vietceramics showrooms nationwide to experience the Tele di Marmo Lumia light-effect brick collection firsthand and discover new ideas to elevate their design concepts.
